issue.title: Retire completion_refresh_on_update
issue.description: After a successful sase update, regenerate, zcompile, and restamp installed shell completion scripts. Off by default while the generator soaks.

task_type_fields.remove_when: The generator has soaked through several `sase update` runs without producing a broken or stale completion script on any supported shell.
task_type_fields.when_disabled: `sase update` leaves installed completion scripts untouched; they refresh only on an explicit `sase completion install`.
task_type_fields.when_enabled: After a successful `sase update`, installed shell completion scripts are regenerated, zcompiled, and restamped.

payload.entry:
PROVENANCE: this bead replaces sase-om, the `flag`-issue-type bead that owned `completion_refresh_on_update` from its creation at 2026-08-17T15:41:43Z by bbugyi200.athena.sase-oc.7 until epic sase-pv phase sase-pv.7 (migrate) deleted it on 2026-08-18. Feature flags are no longer their own bead type, so the old bead could not be converted in place -- the bead store's append-only guard makes `issue_type` immutable after `issue_created` -- and it was removed with `sase bead rm` and re-created here through `create_flag_bead`, the path `sase flag new` uses.

CARRIED OVER UNCHANGED: title, size (small), kind (beta), and both removal thresholds (2026-11-15 / 0.18.0). No deadline moved as a side effect of the migration.

AUTHORED FOR THE NEW REQUIRED FIELDS: `when_enabled`, `when_disabled`, and `remove_when` were drafted in the epic plan and each was verified against the code before it was written here. `src/sase/feature_flags/registry.py` now points `completion_refresh_on_update` at sase-qg.
